svg.aria-label: The lit-review mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake, citation verification: mark only or strict (stop); Literature strategist (agent); You review the sources: add or remove, optional (stop); Annotated bibliography, literature matrix, synthesis (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake: config.md, DOI checking, the research question the run needs [D24, O, AD11, AV15]; a research report and its bibliography [AV1]; the profile [AV2]; a file in words [AQ] (stop); Session: the search themes, clusters of the method areas, each with its scope and target range, in config.md Decisions [The academic-paper strategist] (question); Literature strategist, theme run: search theme 1, review-theme-1.md and refs-theme-1.bib; each included source confirmed by a live lookup, an unconfirmed one excluded and listed [The academic-paper strategist] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme runs: each other search theme, all at once [The academic-paper strategist] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, merge run, fresh: the duplicates removed, each source the theme runs hand on assessed, the searches where the search themes meet, the report over the merged set, the gates computed; review.md, refs.bib [CA] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist: review.md, refs.bib, a .bib patch when a .tex is given; a list over 50 entries shows its first 20 and last 5; it does not start without a research question [D48, D2, AD11, AV15, AV16] (ruled, only when needed); The strategist, one search theme: each included source confirmed by a live lookup, an unconfirmed one excluded and listed [The academic-paper strategist] (ruled); Script, run by the session: lookup.py resolve on each entry's DOI or arXiv ID, once, and the proceedings page of an entry with neither read, into checks.md [The academic-paper strategist] (script); Literature strategist, resumed with checks.md: the differing titles resolved; strict: a failing identifier corrected or removed, once [O] [The academic-paper strategist] (ruled); You review the sources: add or remove, optional [J] (stop); Script, run by the session: lookup.py resolve again on each corrected or added entry's DOI or arXiv ID, into checks.md [O] [The academic-paper strategist] (script); A reference that cannot be confirmed [O] (stop); Script: apply the .bib patch [D48] (script); End (agent); At every patch: a structural patch, a patch that does not apply (retry as often as you ask, write it again in full, or leave it [BR]), a script failed [C] (stop); At every agent start: a model other than the configured one [D47] (stop).
